note: USACE Melvern Lake park halfway along the south shore, on a point. 43 paved sites: 19 with 30-amp electric and water, 24 basic. Showers, flush and vault toilets, drinking water, a dump station, boat ramp and dock; the Tallgrass Heritage Trail starts here. Booked on recreation.gov for May 1-Sep 29. Generators are allowed on basic sites until 10 PM. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + USACE page: fees 16/22 -> 20/24 (2026 peak rates); 30 A/water, 43 sites (rec.gov lists 33), 78 ft max confirmed; pull-throughs, showers, flush/vault toilets, water and dump added; booking on rec.gov, some sites FCFS, 14 nights in 30. Lakefront stands (west-rim sites 09/10/14, 40-55 m across open shore). Pin OK.
flags: FEES CHANGE 16/22 -> 20/24: recreation.gov's rate table shows $24 electric / $20 basic for every peak season 2019-2028, with no off-peak rate. The stored $16/$22 matches nothing I could find.

SITE COUNT: the USACE page says 43 (19 + 24 basic); recreation.gov's description and catalog say 33 (19 + 14). I kept 43. The catalog skips numbers 13, 18-19 and 35-43, which fits about 10 off-system basic sites, so fcfs is 'some_sites'.

SEASON not written: recreation.gov books only May 1-Sep 29 (nothing on the calendar Nov-Apr), and USACE mentions a 'recreation season' with booth hours but gives no dates. Whether the campground stays open first-come off-season is unknown.

WATERFRONT 'lakefront' stands. Sites 09 and 10 (NW spur) and 14 sit on the west rim of the point with no road on the lake side: 09 is about 40 m from the water and 14 about 55 m, across open grass and a pale exposed-shore apron with a few trees. Sites 12 and 07 have more tree cover. The wide pale band is exposed lakebed at low pool, so the water is closer at normal pool.
PIN 38.4903,-95.7617 is about 30 m from the catalog centroid (38.49058,-95.76161), between the two loops. OK.
PHONE 785-549-3318 confirmed (recreation.gov and USACE). WEBSITE recreation.gov fine. Military and interagency discounts not written (recreation.gov flags militaryDiscount; brief says leave it).
